name: DuoPlus Cloud Phone
tagline: Real ARM Android cloud phones as stable, isolated devices, with API, llms.txt and agent Skills
description:
DuoPlus gives teams real ARM Android cloud phones (Android 10, 11, 12 and 15) that you open in a browser or in the Windows/Mac client. Each cloud phone is its own isolated, stable device environment, with local environments in 150+ countries/regions. Agencies use it to keep each client's apps on a separate device and hand devices over with one-click team sharing; app teams use it to test their own APKs across Android versions and regions. Bulk install, uninstall and launch, root support, per-minute billing, an API, and cloud numbers that can receive verification SMS for testing your own app's signup or OTP flow. Android only; check the official site for current rates.

For AI agents: DuoPlus publishes an official llms.txt at duoplus.net/llms.txt and API docs at help.duoplus.net/docs/api-reference. There are two official Skills on ClawHub, DuoPlus AI and DuoPlus Agent, installable from clawhub.ai/duoplusofficial.
